_comment: Custom Python Bot Egg — import via Admin > Nests > Import Egg
name: Python Bot (Git Deploy)
author: wamitiantony297@gmail.com
description: Generic Python bot runner. Pulls source from a Git repo (or uses uploaded files), installs requirements.txt, and runs a chosen Python file on start — same behaviour as bot-hosting.net style panels.
startup: if [[ "${AUTO_UPDATE}" == "1" ]] && [[ -d .git ]]; then git pull; fi; if [[ -f /home/container/${REQUIREMENTS_FILE} ]]; then pip install --disable-pip-version-check --no-cache-dir --user -r ${REQUIREMENTS_FILE}; fi; if [[ ! -z "${ADDITIONAL_PYTHON_PACKAGES}" ]]; then pip install --disable-pip-version-check --no-cache-dir --user ${ADDITIONAL_PYTHON_PACKAGES}; fi; if [[ ! -z "${START_BASH_FILE}" ]]; then bash ${START_BASH_FILE}; else python ${BOT_PY_FILE} ${PYTHON_START_FLAGS}; fi;

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# Python Bot Egg - installation script
# Runs once in a temporary Debian container before first boot.

apt update -y
apt install -y git curl ca-certificates

cd /mnt/server || exit 1

if [[ "${USER_UPLOADED_FILES}" == "1" ]]; then
    echo "USER_UPLOADED_FILES=1 -- skipping git clone, expecting files to be uploaded manually via SFTP/file manager."
else
    if [[ -z "${GIT_REPO_ADDRESS}" ]]; then
        echo "ERROR: GIT_REPO_ADDRESS is empty and USER_UPLOADED_FILES is not 1. Nothing to deploy."
        exit 1
    fi

    REPO_URL="${GIT_REPO_ADDRESS}"

    # Inject auth into the URL if a username + token were provided (private repos)
    if [[ ! -z "${GIT_USERNAME}" ]] && [[ ! -z "${GIT_ACCESS_TOKEN}" ]]; then
        REPO_URL=$(echo "${GIT_REPO_ADDRESS}" | sed "s#https://#https://${GIT_USERNAME}:${GIT_ACCESS_TOKEN}@#")
    fi

    echo "Cloning ${GIT_REPO_ADDRESS} ..."

    if [[ -z "${GIT_BRANCH}" ]]; then
        git clone "${REPO_URL}" .
    else
        git clone --branch "${GIT_BRANCH}" "${REPO_URL}" .
    fi
fi

if [[ -f /mnt/server/${REQUIREMENTS_FILE} ]]; then
    echo "Found ${REQUIREMENTS_FILE}, it will be installed on first boot."
else
    echo "No ${REQUIREMENTS_FILE} found at repo root -- that's fine if your bot has no extra dependencies."
fi

echo "Install script complete."

variables.name: Git Repo Address
variables.description: Git repo to clone, e.g. https://github.com/youruser/your-bot-repo

variables.name: Git Branch
variables.description: Branch to clone/pull. Leave blank for the repo's default branch.

variables.name: Git Username
variables.description: Username to auth with git (only needed for private repos).

variables.name: Git Access Token
variables.description: Personal access token, used as the password for private repos. Never shared with other users.

variables.name: User Uploaded Files
variables.description: Set to 1 if you are uploading files yourself instead of using a git repo (skips git clone).

variables.name: Auto Update
variables.description: Pull the latest files on startup when using a GitHub repo (git pull each boot).

variables.name: Bot Python File
variables.description: The file that starts the bot, e.g. bot.py

variables.name: Requirements File
variables.description: Requirements file to install on boot, if present.

variables.name: Additional Python Packages
variables.description: Extra packages to install on boot, space separated.

variables.name: Python Start Flags
variables.description: Flags passed to python when starting the bot, e.g. -O

variables.name: Start Bash File
variables.description: Optional: if set, this bash script is run instead of python directly (e.g. start.sh).
